# 23. Linting checks the contract against explicit rules

APIOps introduction. Technical continuation is illustrative; no client implementation or measured improvement is claimed.

Verified against the actual Spectral YAML and npm scripts. read-only extends base.yaml and prohibits POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE. full-crud extends the same base and adds no rules. base.yaml extends spectral:oas and checks server URLs against ^/v\d+$, for example /v1. The README wording calling full-crud stricter is not used here because the implementation is authoritative. These are configured rules, not proof of the full style guide or runtime security. No Spectral execution result is claimed.

# 24. API Audit brings evidence together across the lifecycle

APIOps introduction. Technical continuation is illustrative; no client implementation or measured improvement is claimed.

The package audit checklist uses six lifecycle stages: Strategy, Architecture, Design, Delivery, Publishing and Improving. In the inspected default checklist, Improving currently has no checklist items, so teams must add meaningful improvement evidence. The eight core stations remain the navigation model. The audit script reads the canonical package checklist unless a project-local override exists, combines spec checks and manual/default statuses, and emits JSON, Markdown, HTML and JUnit. The table describes evidence expectations; it is not an actual result for this example.

# 25. A check result needs a clear interpretation

APIOps introduction. Technical continuation is illustrative; no client implementation or measured improvement is claimed.

Direct implementation review: checkExamplesPassValidation returns hasAnyExample(spec); checkValidationWorkflowPresent checks file existence; checkOpaqueIdentifiers looks for productId, variantId and categoryId; normalizeStatus returns manual defaultStatus or partial. These limitations are concrete in the inspected local create-apiops 1.1.4 template. The canonical JSON style guide is guidance and linked audit metadata; it is not automatically compiled into a complete Spectral ruleset. Review and extend automation rather than interpreting report generation as verified readiness.

Sources checked 3 November 2026:
packages/create-apiops/template/scripts/run-design-audit.js: checkExamplesPassValidation, checkValidationWorkflowPresent, checkOpaqueIdentifiers, normalizeStatus
src/snippets/api-style-guide.json

# 26. CI can keep the review evidence current

APIOps introduction. Technical continuation is illustrative; no client implementation or measured improvement is claimed.

The inspected .github/workflows/openapi-lint.yml installs with npm ci, lints, generates audit reports and publishes JUnit. It defaults to read-only and supports manual full-crud selection. The audit runner writes reports; its CLI does not itself fail merely because coverage includes gaps. The JUnit publisher step has continue-on-error enabled. Teams should define explicit gating behaviour for the chosen profile and runtime tests. No changes were made to production CI.
